thread:
alec: Quick sync 1: product wants SLOs shown per-route in the Console, but with a single canonical "effective SLO" after routing/overrides. Thoughts?
ravi: We need the canonical source. If Console fabricates the effective SLO from local rules we'll get drift. Prefer backend authority.
tara: Backend makes sense. UX also wants a tiny "why" summary next to the number (2 words max) and a link to details.
alec: Agreed. Backend should also include the top contributing rule so we can show the short summary.
ops-bot: "alert: policy-service CPU spike during sample-explain requests" (this happened earlier, FYI)
ravi: Good point. We must rate-limit explain calls and return cached results for dashboards. Explains can be expensive (joins across quiet windows, tenant overrides, sample histories).
tara: For UI, we need an expandable card: header shows route name + effective SLO pill (green/yellow/red). On expand show: configured SLO, effective SLO, top-2 reasons, time-window used, fingerprint for dedup.
alec: Fingerprint should be stable for deduping alerts (tenant_id + reason_key + route_hash). We'll return a short base64 fingerprint from API.
ops-bot: "deploy: feature flag enable-explain v2 toggled by alec"
ravi: API sketch suggestion: `GET /v1/policy/effective?route=R&tenant=T&detail=short|full`. Short returns minimal fields for list pages. Full returns verbose explain and event ids.
tara: UX prefers short by default. Full behind a "view details" click. Also want the UI to surface whether the SLO is coming from a route-level config or inherited from the service default.
alec: Important: add a hysteresis field to avoid flapping pills (e.g., last_3m median vs last_1m instant). We'll surface both but base the pill on the smoothed value.
ravi: Telemetry: emit `slo.explain.result` as a trace event with attributes: route, tenant, window, effective_slo, fingerprint. Sample at 0.5% for production, 100% for console-triggered full explains.
tara: Can we include a suggested notify-policy id in the explain so UI can suggest "Notify ops"? Product likes lightweight recommendations.
alec: Fine, but make it advisory only. We'll not auto-attach policies. Also enforce RBAC: tenant-scoped data only for tenant admins and engineers with scope.
ops-bot: "audit: user alec viewed effective_slo for tenant TID-42 route R"
ravi: On deduping: alerts should group by fingerprint and use a sliding window to coalesce duplicates. Console will show aggregated counts and link to underlying alerts.
tara: UX/interaction: when user clicks the pill and chooses "start canary", Console should call the rollout API: `POST /internal/rollouts` with payload `{route, tenant, mode: 'canary', reason: fingerprint}` and show immediate success/failure. Audit trail required.
alec: We'll add a `explain_fingerprint` field to the rollout payload for correlation. Rollout API will check privileges and write an audit log event.
ravi: Implementation plan: (1) policy service: `/v1/policy/effective` short/full endpoints, fingerprint generation, caching (TTL 30s), rate-limits; (2) telemetry: add explain.trace + sampling; (3) console: short card, detail panel, canary CTA gated by RBAC; (4) docs + migration notes for alerting teams.
tara: Also add a small toggle: "suppress minor noise" which hides yellow pills if (< 0.5% deviation). Product wants control for noisy dashboards.
alec: Let's be careful: suppression is a UI filter only, not suppressing backend alerts. Must be explicit.
ops-bot: "note: policy-service explain endpoint added to staging at https://staging.policy/v1/policy/effective?route=R&tenant=T&detail=short"
ravi: I'll prep a PR with the API contract and unit tests. Include examples for short/full JSON.
tara: I'll make a tiny mock for the Console to test with staging. Need a sample payload ASAP.
alec: OK I'll post a sample short payload in the API PR and tag you. Any blockers?
ravi: Only one: confirm fingerprint algorithm (HMAC vs deterministic hash). Prefer deterministic hash salted by deployment id. Security team to sign off.
tara: UX: will pick colors and microcopy once we have the short payload fields.
alec: Good. I'll schedule a 30m follow-up if needed. Thanks all :slightly_smiling_face:
